name: Icegram Mailer – Instant, Dependable, and Easy Email Delivery for WordPress
author: Icegram

sections.description:
Icegram Mailer is a powerful email sending service for WordPress & WooCommerce that fixes email delivery issues, offers real-time insights, and needs no external SMTP plugin.

Stop worrying about whether your emails are delivered. Mailer streamlines your email-sending process with a one-time setup and a free plan of 200 emails. Enjoy accurate email logging, real-time insights, and effortless operation—all managed from your WordPress dashboard.

Perfect For

  • Busy site owners and digital marketers
  • Bloggers and content creators
  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Agencies and developers
  • Anyone facing email delivery challenges
  • Users of email marketing plugins like MailPoet, Icegram Express, MailChimp, etc.

Key Features: Empower Your Email Sending

  • Quick Start with Free Emails:
    ➜ Connect to our built-in email sending service to access a free plan (200 emails) and scalable monthly plans.

  • Reliable Email Delivery:
    ➜ Enjoy prompt, secure delivery with our email sending service—no external SMTP plugin required.

  • Email Logging & Analytics:
    ➜ Monitor delivered and opened emails with detailed logs and performance insights.

  • Effortless One-Time Setup:
    ➜ Install and configure Icegram Mailer quickly via your WordPress dashboard—no recurring hassles.

  • Wide Compatibility, Works Everywhere:
    ➜ Seamlessly integrate with top email marketing plugins for WordPress and WooCommerce.

Versatile Email Capabilities: What Can You Send?

Icegram Mailer supports both marketing and transactional emails, making it a perfect email sending service for all your communication needs:

  • Marketing Emails: Newsletters, promotional campaigns, and product announcements.

  • Transactional Emails: Order confirmations, invoices, and account notifications.

  • System Emails: Password resets, account alerts, and other critical system notifications.

  • eCommerce Alerts: Cart abandonment reminders and shipping notifications.

Why Choose Mailer?

✨ Fast & Reliable Delivery:
Ensure your emails always reach the inbox with our built-in email sending service.

📊 Actionable Insights:
Gain detailed reports to optimize every campaign.

⚙️ Hassle-Free Setup:
Enjoy a one-time configuration that saves you time and eliminates third-party SMTP hassles.

🔄 Broad Compatibility:
Use Mailer with top email marketing solutions on WordPress and WooCommerce.

🆓 Try Mailer today for better results guaranteed!

Install & Activate:
👉 Install Mailer directly from your WordPress dashboard in seconds.

Configure Settings:
👉 Create your one-time account, activate your free plan of 200 emails, and choose your preferred sending plan.

Monitor & Analyze:

Scale Effortlessly:

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload icegram-mailer.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Place <?php do_action('plugin_name_hook'); ?> in your templates
sections.faq:
What is Icegram Mailer?

A: Mailer is a standalone Email Sending Service that resolves email delivery issues and provides real-time tracking—without the need for an external SMTP plugin.

How many emails can I send with the trial plan?

A: The trial plan allows you to send 200 emails, so you can test the service before upgrading.

Is Mailer compatible with other email marketing plugins?

A: Yes, Mailer works seamlessly with MailPoet, Icegram Express, MailChimp, FluentCRM, Constant Contact, ActiveCampaign, and other leading email marketing plugins on WordPress and WooCommerce.

How do I monitor my email campaigns?

A: You can view detailed logs and analytics directly from your WordPress dashboard to monitor delivery, opens, and other key metrics.
